issues.description: Class attribute naming mismatch in Exercise 1 two-qubit Grover template: the template's __init__ defines the query register as self._query_register (underscored name) but immediately constructs the QuantumCircuit using self.query_register (non-underscored). The solution implementation uses self.query_register consistently. This mismatch will raise an AttributeError (self.query_register undefined) when a student instantiates the template class and thus blocks running the starter code and mapping to the solution.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the attribute name consistent in the template initializer. Replace the underscored attribute with the non-underscored name used elsewhere, e.g. change
    self._query_register = QuantumRegister(self.number_of_qubits_query_register)
to
    self.query_register = QuantumRegister(self.number_of_qubits_query_register)
and ensure QuantumCircuit is constructed from self.query_register. Also consider setting the placeholder number_of_qubits_query_register to 2 (as in the solution) or document it clearly so students know the intended register size.
